name: Tsuki no Shinden
source:
In the great republic of Polaris, five major religions are held in high regard. The protagonist (female, name changeable) serves as a moon priestess at the Moon Temple there, and she's about to turn sixteen. On that day, her mother, Deneb, tells her, "On your sixteenth birthday, you must choose a partner from among the priests of the other temples."
The high priestess of the Moon Temple has always been a female spirit summoner, so she needs a capable partner to support the temple alongside her.
Over the course of one week, the protagonist must pick one of three marriage candidates.
There are nine endings, plus a hidden character.
The love interests' facial expressions have been animated for added flavor.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/157]freem[/url]]
translation:
在伟大的波拉里斯共和国中，五大宗教备受尊崇。本作主人公（女性，可更改姓名）在月之神殿担任月之巫女，即将迎来十六岁生日。就在这一天，母亲黛内芙向她宣布：“在十六岁生日当天，你必须从其他神殿的神官之中选定一名伴侣。”
月之神殿的最高祭司历代皆由女性召灵师担任，因此亟需一位得力伴侣在身旁共同支撑神殿。
在为期一周的时间里，主人公必须从三名婚约候选人中做出抉择。
本作共设九种结局，并包含一名隐藏可攻略角色；
攻略对象还配有生动的动态表情演出，为故事更添趣味。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/157]Freem![/url]]
